paragraphs.source_en: Dark clouds covered the sky, and a light rain began to fall. The heavens seemed lower than before, yet the heat remained stifling. Unable to restrain himself, Ii Naotaka hurried toward the storehouse.

paragraphs.source_en: At the Kyobashi entrance was a crowd of deserters, elderly people, women, and children who had escaped the castle but had nowhere to go. They had been promised release once the war ended. Had they lost patience and begun to riot because Hideyori still had not emerged from the castle? If they caused an uprising, it would surely provoke another appalling massacre.
